services.name: Youth Summer Camp
services.desc: Designed for young performers ages 8-17, our two-week summer camp gives campers the opportunity to experience what it takes to bring a full musical production to life, from the first rehearsal to the final bow. Working alongside HCCT theatre artists, campers will develop their skills in acting, singing, dancing, character development, stage movement, and ensemble performance as they rehearse and prepare Guys and Dolls Jr. for the HCCT stage. Through the rehearsal process, campers build confidence, creativity, communication skills, teamwork, responsibility, and friendships while learning what it means to be part of an ensemble.
